From proposal to kickoff

How we got here

Four years of plans, hearings, demolition and construction transformed the site.

  1. Sept. 2022

    A new vision

    Northwestern unveils plans to replace the century-old stadium with a smaller, modern venue.

  2. Nov. 2023

    City approval

    Evanston officials approve the redevelopment after months of public debate and negotiation.

  3. Jan. 2024

    Demolition begins

    Crews start dismantling the old Ryan Field, clearing the site for construction.

  4. 2025

    Stadium takes shape

    The seating bowl, canopy and surrounding public spaces rise along Central Street.

  5. Fall 2026

    Opening season

    The Wildcats return home and a new era of football in Evanston begins.
